description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named AdminController, which provides administrative endpoints for managing user roles and account states within an insurance management system. It includes endpoints for listing roles, assigning roles to users, enabling/disabling users, and a protected endpoint for agents.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: REST controller providing administrative endpoints for user management in the system.

methods.name: listRoles
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all roles in the system, restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: assignRoles
methods.description: Handles POST requests to assign roles to a user identified by userId, requires ADMIN role.

methods.name: toggleUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to enable or disable a user account based on userId and enabled flag, restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: agentOnly
methods.description: Handles GET requests to a protected endpoint accessible only by users with AGENT role.
